purpose: Strengthen Thought-Action-Observation: a successful execution must satisfy the frozen requested result contract before publication.
changes: Typed result postconditions are created and semantically reviewed before generated Python; execution cannot rewrite them.
Independent reference verifies requested column order, row count, numeric values, missing values and sorted observation order.
Semantic mismatches publish no dataset and produce bounded code-repair observations preserving original scope and data.
Legacy receipts and receipts for a different contract cannot satisfy completion or task dependencies.
Plans persist expected postconditions and accepted verification receipts.
Discovery-stall recovery reads the actual automatic/manual SQL authorization policy.
Historical derived columns no longer contaminate input candidates for another visible result of the same source.
Only selected capabilities contribute option descriptions to the detailed goal role.
Unquoted sentence-ending punctuation no longer becomes a qualified database address.
Complete rolling windows are the default; smaller min_periods requires a CURRENT user quote for partial-window intent.
Worker output may contain extra input-reference columns; project only the frozen outputs and independently verify every requested value. Unexpected derived columns are still rejected.
Code-result failures retain execute_analysis_python as a repair candidate with corrected arguments; unchanged repeats remain bounded.

checks: df.copy() is not accepted as rolling mean
wrong rolling window or sum instead of mean fails
mismatch then corrected code completes through actual graph
original digest unchanged and no rejected output publication
historical computed column excluded unless its result is referenced

actual_browser_validation.request: 방금 다운로드한 10개 행만 사용해 age를 오름차순 정렬한 뒤 두 행씩 이동평균 age_rolling을 Python으로 계산해서 표로 보여줘. 원본은 그대로 유지하고 DB는 다시 조회하지 마.

preserved_failures.failure: historical derived input chosen; repair exceeded conservative input budget
invented partial window and result semantic mismatch; real model recovery did not finish in budget
Correct complete-window calculation returned an extra input-reference column; strict formatting caused unnecessary repair and exhausted time budget. Fixed by explicit presentation-only projection.

remaining_limits: A natural-language goal and semantic reviewer remain fallible; numeric verification proves the frozen supported contract, not every possible interpretation of human language.
Arbitrary Python mathematics outside this result grammar must clarify or remain unverified; do not claim general Python analysis completeness.
Independent task populations, multiple tasks of the same capability and a general execution DAG remain incomplete.
Recovery orchestration remains large; new verification/context responsibilities are separated but the entire recovery module is not refactored.
macOS/Windows worker has no hard OS RSS limit; the independent verifier budget is an estimate.
Large-scale production data transfer/performance, full held-out dialogue replay, official DeepEval/Spider scores and company Windows/Azure/Databricks end-to-end verification are not established.
